Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

I, {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }}, have been appointed on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} as an Enquiry Officer by Sahayog Management in the case against {{ doc.employee_name }} (Emp ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}, {{ doc.designation }}) of {{ doc.branch_name }} branch on the alleged charges of {{ doc.issue_in_details }}, from {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} to till date.

Background:

On {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }} was appointed as Management Representative. Through the mail dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, it was informed that {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.designation }}) has proceeded on an Unauthorized Absence from {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}. The complaint mail is attached as Annexure-1.

On the scheduled date of enquiry, I along with the Management Representative was present, however the alleged employee did not present himself.

Submissions from Management Representative:

The Management Representative first presented the Attendance Sheet – Evidence 1, indicating absence for the period. Attempts made to connect the employee were also documented. Attendance sheet is attached as Annexure-2.

The Unauthorized Absence Letter – Evidence 2 & Reminder Unauthorized Absence Letter – Evidence 3, dated accordingly, were then presented. Copy of Unauthorized Absence Letter is attached as Annexure-3 & Reminder Unauthorized Absence Letter is attached as Annexure-4.

Apart from the above, Registered Post Acknowledgement Due and online tracking was presented – Evidence 4. RPAD Status is attached as Annexure-4.

Observation during enquiry:

• {{ doc.remarks or "No observations recorded." }}

Enquiry Findings:

Based on the evidence produced by the Management Representative, it is concluded that there are adequate evidences to support that {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.designation }}) has violated Company’s rules and is guilty of the charges mentioned in the Unauthorized Absence Letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_occurrence_date, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Annexure-1: Complaint Mail

Annexure-2: Attendance Sheet

Annexure-3: Unauthorized Absence Letter
